values.meaning: Minimum Bonus Magic Damage (on-hit, per soul, no AD ratio)
Maximum Bonus Magic Damage (on-hit, per soul, plus scaling AD ratio after 10s no-attack)

mechanics.claim: The passive AD ratio on the empowered attack grows over 10 seconds without basic-attacking an enemy, reaching maximum at that point.
mechanics.quote: with the {{sti|{{as|AD}}}} ratio increasing over 10 seconds without basic attacking enemies

mechanics.claim: The active applies area damage on cast and the passive empowered attack deals a separate proc damage instance.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|area damage}} on the ability and deals {{tip|proc damage}} on the enhanced basic attack.

mechanics.claim: The enhanced attack applies on-hit effects and can critically strike, but the bonus passive damage itself cannot crit.
mechanics.quote: The enhanced attack applies other [[on-hit effect]]s and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal (the bonus damage cannot).

mechanics.claim: Effects of the active start at the beginning of the cast time rather than at its end.
mechanics.quote: ''Flay's'' effects start at the start of the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Slow duration after being hit by the active lasts 1 second.
